comment: The filter CVs are tested with `!= 0.0f` rather than by whether the jack is patched, and when non-zero they replace the knob: the frequency becomes the geometric centre of the range multiplied by two to the power of the volts. Those centres are not stored as such; they are the log2 constants LPF_CENTER_LOG and HPF_CENTER_LOG in src/ChanIn.cpp:931-932, which are log2(4472.14) and log2(100). The expander writes its HPF jack into msg->hpfFreqCV and CHAN-IN reads that field into its low-pass CV (src/ChanIn.cpp:1181-1182, commented `Swapped`); the two swaps cancel, so the jack printed HPF really does move the knob printed HPF. The PHASE jack has no attenuverter. The expander is inert unless CHAN-IN is the module immediately to its left.
